if: the activity or transaction is specified in Schedule III
then: it is treated NEITHER as a supply of goods NOR as a supply of services — no time of supply and no value of supply arise, and no GST entry is posted
note: s.7(2) opens 'Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1)', so this overrides s.7(1). Schedule III is not extracted, so the list cannot be checked here.
